name: Alliance Laundry Holdings Inc.
description: Alliance Laundry Holdings Inc is a designer and manufacturer of commercial laundry systems, serving diverse international markets. The company offers premium, durable laundry equipment under brands like Speed Queen, UniMac, Huebsch, Primus, IPSO, and others. It serves commercial laundry needs across healthcare, hotels, laundromats, and residential markets. Revenue is generated through the sale of commercial-grade laundry systems and service parts across two geographic segments, North America and International, and into the three end markets of OPL, Vended, and Commercial In-Home.
